title: Dhongee
overview: Anand an insurance agent is a lovable person lives with his sister Geeta and in love with Neelima. His only dream is to get Geeta married soon but his problem is that he can't arrange for the dowry. Anand is framed in a fake currency case by John and his gang he meets with an accident and is termed dead. But Anand is very much alive and returns to take revenge by pretending to be another person.

songs.title: Woh Hai Ek Behroopiya
songs.singers: Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle, Amit Kumar
